purpose: Sanitized interface evidence for AC0 (Usage.InterfaceEvidence). No fixture here is a captured provider response unless its provenance says Observed.

host.notes: Read-only, non-prompt inspection of installed CLIs. No provider request was made, no credential was read and no model prompt was sent.

fixtures.notes: Field names match Armada's ClaudeRateLimitEvent/ClaudeRateLimitInfo DTOs, which Armada already parses from live mission output. The window names five_hour, seven_day, seven_day_opus and seven_day_sonnet were found as literal strings in the installed 2.1.316 binary. The event is only produced while a real mission runs, so no live event was captured here.

Structure, nullability and field names come from the schema bundle generated by the installed codex-cli 0.163.0. All numbers, plan values and reset timestamps are invented. The backend also returns a nullable accountId; Armada must HMAC it on the credential host and never persist it.

clientInfo is the only required initialize property. capabilities is optional and experimentalApi defaults to false; account/rateLimits/read is listed in the generated ClientRequest union without requiring experimentalApi.

fixtures.interface: error body only; no account-limit read interface
fixtures.notes: Shape of a Google API 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED error as recognized by RuntimeProviderErrorParser. It carries no reliable reset value, so no reset may be inferred from it. The gemini CLI is not installed on this host, so the CLI interface itself is unverified.

fixtures.interface: run_completed usage object, per-run accounting only
fixtures.notes: Field names match Armada's MuxRunUsage DTO, which parses the structured output contract v2 run_completed event. Values are invented. This is token and cost accounting, never a remaining-quota reading.

fixtures.interface: allowlisted response headers for an Anthropic endpoint
fixtures.notes: Header names are the documented Anthropic rate-limit response headers. Values are invented. Nothing is captured until a real inference response is observed through the Armada transport.

fixtures.interface: allowlisted response headers for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
fixtures.notes: Header names follow the documented OpenAI rate-limit header family. Reset values are duration strings, not timestamps, and compatible servers may omit every one of them. Values are invented.
This is the contract shape defined by CAPTAIN_USAGE_PLAN.md, not a capture from an installed executable. accountKey is a placeholder for the host HMAC; no executable exists on this host.
